name: Jest of the Flash Fog
body:
School: Transmutation; Level: jester 6

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Personal

Target: You

Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You gain the ability to move through objects and creatures as if they were difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.
